repo.name: demo-repo
repo.scope_summary: Demo blueprint analysis covering the compact customer onboarding service.

confidence.reason: The demo repository is compact and contains explicit controller, service, contract and documentation evidence.

limitations.title: Demo depth
limitations.summary: This v2 example is intentionally concise and does not replace a full complete-audit run.

executive_decision.summary: The repository is a compact customer onboarding service with enough explicit source and documentation evidence to produce a blueprint decision report.
executive_decision.recommended_action: Use blueprint mode for the default decision report and reserve complete-audit for exhaustive file-card coverage.

decision_options.title: Blueprint analysis
decision_options.summary: Start with the v2 analysis document because the repository already exposes REST endpoints and service flow evidence.

top_risks.title: External KYC dependency
top_risks.summary: Identity verification is delegated to a KYC client, so modernization decisions need integration detail.

next_steps.title: Inspect integration contracts
next_steps.summary: Review OpenAPI and WSDL files before making interface migration decisions.

functional_view.system_purpose: Customer onboarding accepts customer requests, checks identity and risk, persists customer state and publishes onboarding events.

actors.title: Customer onboarding API caller
actors.summary: Calls the REST controller to start onboarding and check customer status.

capabilities.title: Start onboarding
capabilities.summary: The service starts onboarding from a request and returns a result containing status, risk score and KYC reference.

user_or_system_flows.name: Start onboarding
user_or_system_flows.summary: REST request enters the controller, delegates to the service, runs duplicate, KYC and risk checks, persists the customer and publishes an event.

steps.description: The service checks duplicates, verifies identity, scores risk, saves state and publishes the onboarding event.

mermaid.source:
sequenceDiagram
  participant Caller
  participant Controller
  participant Service
  participant KYC
  Caller->>Controller: POST /customers/onboard
  Controller->>Service: startOnboarding(request)
  Service->>KYC: verifyIdentity(...)
  Service-->>Controller: OnboardingResult
  Controller-->>Caller: 202 Accepted

technical_view.architecture_summary: A REST controller delegates onboarding work to an application service that coordinates repository, KYC, risk scoring and event publisher collaborators.

entrypoints.title: POST /customers/onboard
entrypoints.summary: Starts onboarding and returns an accepted onboarding response.

data_and_state.title: Manual review or activation state
data_and_state.summary: KYC approval and risk score decide whether a pending customer moves to manual review or active.

integrations.title: KYC client
integrations.summary: The service calls a KYC client to verify identity.

code_quality_findings.title: Integration behavior needs focused tests
code_quality_findings.summary: The service has branch behavior around KYC approval and risk score; complete evaluation should inspect tests for those paths.

process_analysis.test_readiness: Blueprint evidence is sufficient to identify service branches that should be covered by tests.

delivery_risks.title: Contract and dependency review
delivery_risks.summary: REST and external identity verification contracts should be reviewed before migration planning.

target_architecture_options.title: Keep controller-service separation
target_architecture_options.summary: The existing controller delegates to service logic cleanly enough to preserve the boundary in a modernization.

migration_roadmap.title: Contract inventory
migration_roadmap.benefit: Confirms REST and KYC/SOAP contract behavior before implementation changes.

quick_wins.title: Document risk thresholds
quick_wins.benefit: The risk threshold at score > 70 is a business rule that should be visible in docs and tests.

open_questions.reason: The v2 demo analysis does not include scanner import artifacts.

strengths: Covers executive, functional, technical, quality, process and refactoring views.
limitations: Scanner imports and exhaustive source-tier coverage are not included in this v2 demo.
